description: Generate a video world from a text prompt with the Cosmos Predict 2B model.
inputInstructions:
Generates a video from a text prompt using Cosmos-Predict. No input file is required — the prompt is the input.

Asset metadata this pipeline reads (optional):
  COSMOS_PREDICT_PROMPT  The generation prompt. Used when the Prompt field is left blank.

How to supply metadata: set these as metadata on the ASSET (Metadata tab on the asset page, or `vamscli metadata create`). Keys are case-sensitive.

Precedence: a value you type into a field above WINS. Asset metadata is used only where the field is left blank, so a standing value on the asset acts as a per-asset default.

tagSchema.label: Prompt
tagSchema.description: The generation prompt. Leave blank to fall back to the COSMOS_PREDICT_PROMPT key on the asset's metadata.
